punchline: In a Cleveland Clinic data set, low treadmill fitness carried about five times the mortality risk of elite fitness.
thirty_sec: A Cleveland Clinic study of 122,007 treadmill tests found low fitness carried about five times the mortality risk of elite fitness, comparable to or above smoking and diabetes. It is observational. Attia builds on this: VO2 max, he says, may be the strongest longevity marker, and he asks for easy talkable cardio, hard intervals and strength work.
